notes.title: EYEPATCH
notes.content:
- New title screen 
- Permanent unlocks between levels
- Stopped certain power up abilities going through walls

notes.title: EYEPATCH!
notes.content:
The resolution has gone from 512x512 to 1024x768! There's also now a dynamic camera that follows the player or moves towards the players focus!  Bosses will no longer be hammering you from out of your view and players can better plan their defence.  It's a win-win!

There's also a new title screen, and you get permanent powerup unlocks between each level!

Some enemies and power ups have been tweaked too!
